opportunities.title: Visiting research fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers, academics or curators working on historic and contemporary sculpture, including those focusing on Henry Moore, can apply. Fellowships are offered at the Henry Moore Institute in Leeds or the Henry Moore Studios & Gardens in Hertfordshire.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships enable artists and researchers to spend a month using the Foundation's facilities, covering travel, subsistence and accommodation, with expense allocations up to £600 (UK), £700 (Europe) or £1,000 (rest of world). Applications are closed for 2026/27 and will reopen in spring 2027.
